column1: # ELF64 relocatable object oracle (spec §4.8 AS-6). Each case is assembled by `unisacc as` and the
# whole object is compared byte-for-byte with: every "bytes" row placed at its offset, every other
# byte zero, and the exact total size. Hand-derived from the System V ABI generic ELF chapters
# (ELF header, section header, symbol table, relocation entries) and the AS-6 layout rules, not
# from product output. "." in hex only separates fields for review.
# case rows: case ID ISA TEXT TOTAL CITE.  bytes rows: bytes ID OFFSET HEX CITE.
